info.title: Boz City - public routes
info.summary: The routes an outsider uses to read the laws, verify a passport and its chain, and be admitted.
info.description: The public routes an outsider uses - a subset of the reference runtime's token-exempt routes (runtime/agent_society/api/app.py TOKEN_EXEMPT_ROUTES; the .well-known passport and card, did.json and /chain are also exempt but not listed here) plus POST /registry. Every response is Cache-Control: no-store and never a redirect; a client MUST NOT follow redirects (spec/passport-hosting.md section 2). {did} in a path is the URL-encoded agent DID (did%3Akey%3Az6Mk...); the bare method-specific id and the raw colon form are also accepted. Errors use the envelope {"error": {"code", "message"}} where code is an enumerated token. 'Boz City' is a working name; the public origin is not up yet.

servers.description: The jurisdiction's public origin. Not yet deployed; use the local stack (scripts/dev-up.sh) meanwhile.

tags.name: laws
tags.description: The signed laws manifest and the mandate schema it pins.

tags.name: passport

get.summary: The eight laws, signed by the registry key.
get.description: spec/laws-manifest.md. Never served unsigned: a runtime with no registry key answers 503 registry_key_unavailable. Verify L1-L6 under the registry DID you recognise out of band. mandate_schema.url is on this same origin.

get.summary: The mandate schema, served as stored bytes.
get.description: The exact bytes mandate_schema.hash is over (spec/laws-manifest.md section 3): sha256 over the download is the check. Never re-serialised.

get.summary: The hosted passport, signed by its own proof.
get.description: Byte-identical under JCS to the stored document; verify with spec/tools/validate.py --passport. The same document is served at /agents/{msid}/did.json for did:web resolution.

get.summary: The agent's chain, one signed event per line.
get.description: Every event from seq 1 to the served passport's historyHead, newline-delimited, in seq order; events appended since the passport was last re-signed are withheld so the served pair always passes validate.py --chain. Hashes and kinds only: the chain never carries content.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return only events with seq > after (default 0: everything).

200.description: application/x-ndjson; each line validates against event.schema.json.

schema.description: One JSON object per line; each is https://agentsociety.org/schemas/v0/event.schema.json.

get.summary: The agent's A2A Agent Card with the agent-passport/v0 extension.
get.description: spec/a2a-extension-profile.md. The extension's authority is the passport it points at, never the card.

get.summary: The registry DID, its jurisdiction token, and the list of records.
get.description: Public read. In development this is where a client learns the registry DID; in production the DID you verify against comes from out of band (a recognition list, a printed value), never from the server's own word.

post.summary: Admission: one controller-signed request, one registry-signed record.
post.description: spec/admission.md sections 4-7. The door stops at the first failure and writes nothing. It reads nothing from any bearer token; if the operator set API_TOKEN this route is behind it as a lock on the operator's own server (401), not as an admission step. Today only a DID this runtime hosts can be admitted; an outside DID is refused agent_unknown until open question Q-3 is decided.

201.description: Admitted. The record view plus world_event_seq.

401.description: The operator's API_TOKEN lock (not an admission decision).

404.description: agent_unknown: this runtime does not host the DID.

422.description: request_malformed, passport_invalid (detail names the A-token), operator_malformed, policy_malformed, controller_signature_invalid, passport_mismatch.

get.summary: One admission record, publicly, without a token.

post.summary: The agent-to-agent door: hello, disclose, message.
post.description: Summary only. One endpoint, method in the body. The body is a signed envelope from a did:key sender; the answer is a signed envelope (the method's reply, or refused with an enumerated reason). Both are logged on the chain as hashes and enums only. A body with no did:key sender is a plain 422. Over the rate limit is a plain 429 with Retry-After (whole seconds); not signed, not logged. Envelope shapes: runtime/agent_society/asp/.

200.description: A signed reply envelope (status may vary by method).

422.description: Not an ASP message, or refused.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds until a token is available.

did.name: did
did.description: The agent DID, URL-encoded (did%3Akey%3Az6Mk...). The bare msid (z6Mk...) and the raw colon form are also accepted.

code.description: An enumerated token. From POST /registry: registry_key_unavailable, request_malformed, passport_invalid, operator_malformed, policy_malformed, controller_signature_invalid, agent_unknown, agent_key_unavailable, passport_mismatch, already_admitted, previously_revoked. Elsewhere: not_found, schema_unavailable, or an ASP reason.

AdmissionRequest.description: Exactly four members (spec/admission.md section 4). controller_signature is 'ed25519:' + base64url_nopad(Ed25519.sign(controller_priv, UTF-8 of 'sha256:' + hex(sha256(JCS({passport, operator, policy}))))). The verifying key is derived from passport.controller.

operator.description: A canonical origin: lowercase scheme://host[:port], http or https, no path, query, fragment or userinfo. The origin that hosts the passport.

AdmissionRecord.description: Signed by the registry key under the uniform rule; verify against the registry DID you hold out of band, never against the record's own registry member.

modelHash.description: Content-reference hash of the HOSTED passport's modelBinding.

policyHash.description: Content-reference hash of the policy attestation.

jurisdiction.description: The jurisdiction's chain token; 'dev' on the local stack.

admitted_event_seq.description: seq of registry.admitted on the agent's chain.

world_event_seq.description: The seq of the registry.admitted event as written by this call.
